settings.reference: GLORYS reanalysis, harmonised to the 0.25 degree grid

bootstrap.kind: moving-block bootstrap over the days of each period (as R2)

decision.rule: a reduced input set is adopted only if its mean validation-year RMSE is lower than the full set's by more than the seed spread (the larger sample SD over seeds of the two sets); the lowest adopted set wins, otherwise all seven inputs are kept
decision.criterion: validation-year (2022) RMSE of the kept checkpoint, pooled over all depths
decision.spread: max(SD over seeds of the full set, SD over seeds of the candidate)

full.label: All seven inputs
full.inputs: SST, salinity, sea level, currents, winds

note: The decision uses validation numbers only. The test-year scores below are reported for every candidate after the fact and played no part in it.
